yaquiSources.title: Los yaquis y las crecientes del río. Una historia del control hidráulico del río Yaqui — selected pages
yaquiSources.publisher: Esther Padilla Calderón; Culturales, Universidad Autónoma de Baja California
yaquiSources.author: Esther Padilla Calderón
yaquiSources.annotation: A historian’s analysis of changing relationships among river floods, cultivation and hydraulic infrastructure. The selected pages connect Yaqui settlement and farming with river change; this is a Sonora historical study, not Texas migration evidence. Its arguments and cited archival documents should be distinguished from directly inspected primary records.
yaquiSources.contentReviewScope: Publisher record plus actual publisher PDF: printed pp. 67–69, 75–80 and 97–99 (PDF pages 1–3, 9–14 and 31–33 of 40). Title page visually inspected. Remaining narrative and bibliography were not content-reviewed; figure captions in selected text were read, but maps/figures were not visually evaluated or reused.
yaquiSources.countReason: Substantive selected narrative inspected in the actual publication; one work, not separate counts for record, PDF and mirrors.

inspectedSubresources.title: Publisher full-text PDF
inspectedSubresources.scope: Selected printed pages 67–69, 75–80 and 97–99; complete available PDF downloaded for private reading, not fully reviewed.

yaquiSources.accessNotes: Public Spanish full text, with English abstract; no account or paywall encountered. Web-tool PDF retrieval failed, but the publisher PDF downloaded normally with PowerShell; the PDF text and title frame were inspected. Publisher states CC BY 4.0 and PDF title page bears CC BY; link-only use proposed. Historical generalizations are attributed; present water rights, allocation and conditions were not established.

yaquiSources.title: La recuperación de la memoria de la mujer yaqui: una mirada a la solidaridad, colectividad y agencia
yaquiSources.publisher: Edna Lucía García Rivera; Alteridades, Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana
yaquiSources.author: Edna Lucía García Rivera
yaquiSources.citation: García Rivera, Edna Lucía. 2023. “La recuperación de la memoria de la mujer yaqui: una mirada a la solidaridad, colectividad y agencia.” Alteridades 33(65): 9–19. https://doi.org/10.24275/uam/izt/dcsh/alteridades/2023v33n65/Garcia
yaquiSources.annotation: An oral-history study centered on two older women living in Pótam, Sonora. Their family memories and the author’s analysis address displacement, return and community responsibility. It supplies attributed individual perspectives and an explicit method, not a representative survey of all Yaqui women or independent verification of every remembered event.
yaquiSources.contentReviewScope: Actual publisher PDF narrative and notes, printed pp. 9–18 (PDF pages 1–10 of 11), including introduction/method, historical context, both interview cases and final considerations. Bibliography on pp. 18–19 inspected as references only; cited books/articles not separately reviewed. Title page visually inspected.
yaquiSources.countReason: Substantive published oral-history narrative actually inspected; interviewees’ accounts and scholarly interpretation remain attributed.

inspectedSubresources.scope: Narrative and notes on printed pp. 9–18; references are leads rather than additional checked works.

yaquiSources.accessNotes: Public Spanish full text with English abstract; no account/paywall encountered. No interview transcript, audio, private records, restricted cultural material or documentary photographs reproduced; original publication remains linked.
